title: Low back pain burden: current vs if major risk factors were fixed

source.name: Global Burden of Disease 2021 study, modifiable risk factor analysis for low back pain
source.publisher: Lancet Rheumatology / Global Burden of Disease collaboration

notes: Researchers estimated that addressing obesity, smoking, and occupational ergonomic risk factors could reduce the global burden of low back pain by about 39%, framed here as the share of today's burden that is tied to those preventable factors.
